title: docs(skills): seeds.md teaches the blank-key load refusal and the unknown-object save refusal
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuEoKvgs2TW7hc47KRGVnwtY)_

Fixes #35480
Fixes #35456

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用技能写初始化数据的作者（多数是 AI）会被告知两条规矩：每条记录都要填上用来识别它的键值，否则这一条在加载时被拒收；运行时保存的初始化数据必须指向一个已存在的对象，否则保存被拒。
- 为什么做：这两条拒收都已经在主干上线，对外发布的数据技能还没写；属于「已发布技能与运行时保持一致」这条线，替按技能写数据的应用作者解决。
- 出错会怎样：只改说明文字和两条评测，不改运行时；写错了作者会按错的说明写数据，撤回本次合并即可恢复原文。
- 要你做什么：这份改动动了对外发布的技能文字并按既有裁决抬高了一个文件的字数上限（先删重复、余额按实测），请在席位核对之后审阅并决定是否合入。

## What changes

Two commits, one per card.

| Commit | Card | Text | Eval |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `b3b374b39` | the keyed-record card (first `Fixes` line) | `### externalId selection` gains the rule; the `externalId` row points at it; three restatements cut | case id 34 |
| `20c06ad50` | the unknown-object card (second `Fixes` line) | a note under the field table; the `object` row points at it | case id 35 |

Both land in `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` and `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`, with one changeset (`@objectstack/skills`, patch) and the `seeds.md` row of `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`.

### What the skill now says, and where main says it

Every sentence is a reading of `origin/main` at `03bce5c22`.

**Keyed records (commit `b3b374b39`).** "Every record carries a value for each `externalId` field (each field of a list; `name` when the seed names none). One left blank (no value, `null` or `''`; whitespace is a value) is refused at load in every mode: the result names the object, record index, field and fix, and the other records still load."

- Keyed modes are `upsert`, `update`, `ignore`: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts:1840`. Those are every mode the skill teaches (`insert` / `replace` are refused, as the same file already says), so the skill says "in every mode".
- Blank is `undefined`, `null` or `''`, with no trim: `seed-loader.ts:469-471` (`isBlankSeedKeyValue`, docblock: "A whitespace-only value is a value here (no trim)").
- The default key is `name`: `seed-loader.ts:69` (`DEFAULT_EXTERNAL_ID_FIELD`), and the refusal says so: `seed-loader.ts:493-494`.
- Any component of a composite key: `seed-loader.ts:2346` filters every key field.
- The refusal names the object, the record index, the blank field(s) and the fix: `seed-loader.ts:506-510`.
- The record is skipped and the loop goes on, so the others load; it is reported in the load result: `seed-loader.ts:2347-2364` (`errors.push`, `continue`).
- Pinned by `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader-empty-key-warn.test.ts:139` (composite component, single field, default `name`; siblings converge).

**Unknown object (commit `20c06ad50`).** "A `seed` saved at runtime names its `object` itself. One that resolves to nothing is refused: `422 INVALID_METADATA` at `object`, "which is not defined". Correct the name to the object's full name (`crm_lead`, not `lead`) or create the object first: a draft of it is enough for a draft seed; a live seed needs it published."

- The save door alone asks it (`door === 'save'`); the publish promotion and the restore doors leave it to the load: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts:1087-1091`.
- `422 INVALID_METADATA`, one finding at path `object`: `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts:1180-1192`.
- The door's own words, "which is not defined", "Correct the name to the object's full name (e.g. 'crm_lead', not 'lead')", "a draft of it is enough for this draft", "or create and publish the object first": `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts:1174-1184`.
- Pinned by `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.seed-external-id-refusal.test.ts:381-421` (draft save, publish save, and a publish save whose object is only a draft).

**Doors not taught.** `os validate` and `os build` judge seed record values (`packages/cli/src/utils/seed-record-values.ts`), not a blank key and not a seed's object; the skill names only the load (first rule) and the runtime save (second rule).

### Token budget: the standing ruling, and the deletion

`seeds.md` was at 1759 of 1759 tokens. The raise follows the standing ruling in the header of `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (maintainer, 2026-10-27, ruling record 6513306068), verbatim:

> 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」

Deletion in the same file, shown in the diff of commit `b3b374b39`:

- the `columns` row's shape literal (`{ FIELD: { applyOn: 'create' } }`), which its own section and code block show;
- the one-row best-practices table, now one sentence with the same content;
- the second telling of what a refused seed value leaves behind ("leaves the table short or empty while sibling rows point at records that do not exist"), which the validation paragraph above it already says ("a refused row never lands").

| Reading | Before | After |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `seeds.md` lines | 182 | 190 (+8) |
| `seeds.md` bytes | 7033 | 7590 |
| `seeds.md` tokens (`ceil(bytes / 4)`) | 1759 | 1898 (+139) |
| `seeds.md` ceiling row | 1759 | 1898 (headroom 0, pinned at the measurement) |
| bundle, ratcheted (authored) tokens | 196132 | 196271 (+139) |
| bundle, eval fixtures (not ratcheted) | 70045 | 70589 (+544) |
| bundle total, whole shipped tree | 280730 | 281413 (+683) |

Arithmetic in bytes: 7033 to 6905 after the cuts (-128); the first rule nets +340 (7245, ceiling 1812); the second +345 (7590, ceiling 1898). The cuts pay for 128 bytes of 813; the remainder is the measured raise.

### Contradiction search (the second card's done-when)

`grep -rni seed skills/objectstack-data --include=*.md` outside `seeds.md`: `SKILL.md` :5, :6, :20, :221, :295, :451; `references/_index.md` :16, :44; `references/data-hooks.md` :484; `rules/lifecycle.md` :188; `rules/field-types.md` :13, :53. None speaks of a seed's `object` or of a record's key value. Inside `seeds.md`, one sentence contradicted the new note: the `object` row's "never write manually". It now reads "hand-written only in a runtime save (below)". The examples in the file all carry their key field (`code`, `slug`, `number`, `email`, `name`).

## Tests

No runtime code changes; nothing to unit-test. Two eval cases:

- id 34: an `upsert` seed keyed on `code` where two records have none. Expected: the answer gives each record a value or keys on a field every record carries, and says the record is refused at load.
- id 35: a draft seed saved with `object: 'lead'` when the object is `crm_lead`. Expected: the 422 at `object` with the reason, the full name as the fix, and that the draft object is enough for a draft seed.

Placed directly after the existing seed cases (ids 4, 30, 31), away from the end of the array. `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` at `20c06ad50`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` (merges cleanly with `origin/main` and the three open pulls sharing a file).

## Acceptance notes

- Local gates are a declared subset: the skills, changeset and script families the diff derives. The build-reading families (`check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:published-files`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`), `check:pm-dispatch-gates` and the rest of the derived list are left to CI.
- `check:skill-examples` answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` locally (exit 3, the client SDK is not built in this worktree): NOT MEASURED, not red.
- The card names three anchors for the first rule. The rule is stated once, in `### externalId selection`, with a pointer from the `externalId` row; the composite-key sentence is covered by "each field of a list".
- This pull touches `skills/**`, a governed surface: it stays a draft, with no reviewer request and no auto-merge from this side.

## Verification

Read first: `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` (the two added paragraphs and the three cuts), then the `seeds.md` row comment in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` and look for the line `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md 1898 / 1898 (+0)` and the closing line "59 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings".
